review.reason: This is a narrow, localized maintenance and UX improvement: converting two static HTML elements into clickable links within a frontend view. It improves usability but does not demonstrate broader systemic risk reduction, correctness improvements across critical paths, or substantive capability expansion. Tier 2 requires visible implementation of bounded capability or reliability checks; this lacks such depth. Tier 3 requires broader impact evidence absent here.
review.posthog_relevance: Provides minor user experience benefit by enabling direct navigation from the Inbox waiting-for-work screen, potentially reducing clicks and improving discoverability of settings/scouts. This could help operators manage signals more efficiently, though it does not prevent incidents or improve core PostHog functionality.
review.uncertainty: The exact downstream behavior depends on whether these destination URLs resolve correctly in all environments, which cannot be verified without runtime context.
